description: This Java source file implements the StuckJobExecutorService, responsible for detecting, handling, and restarting stuck batch jobs, including partitioned and tasklet jobs within the Apache Fineract framework.

classes.name: StuckJobExecutorServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that manages detection, handling, and restarting of stuck batch jobs, including partitioned and tasklet jobs.

methods.name: resumeStuckJob
methods.description: Main public method to resume a stuck job given its name; determines job type and triggers appropriate restart logic.

methods.name: restartTaskletJobs
methods.description: Handles restarting of non-partitioned tasklet jobs by invoking jobOperator.restart on each stuck job ID.

methods.name: handleStuckTaskletJob
methods.description: Restarts a specific stuck tasklet job via JobOperator.

methods.name: restartPartitionedJobs
methods.description: Handles restarting of partitioned jobs by processing each stuck partitioned job.

methods.name: isPartitionedJob
methods.description: Checks if the specified job name corresponds to a partitioned job.

methods.name: getPartitionerStepName
methods.description: Retrieves the partitioner step name associated with a partitioned job.

methods.name: areThereStuckJobs
methods.description: Checks whether there are any stuck jobs for a given job name.

methods.name: getStuckJobIds
methods.description: Fetches list of IDs of stuck jobs for a given job name.

methods.name: handleStuckPartitionedJob
methods.description: Handles restarting a stuck partitioned job, including waiting for partition completion and updating the job status.

methods.name: waitUntilAllPartitionsFinished
methods.description: Polls until all partitions of a job are finished before proceeding.

methods.name: areAllPartitionsCompleted
methods.description: Checks whether all partitions of a job have completed.
